strategies.name: Sequential all-reduce with per-stage scaling
strategies.desc: Performs 8 sequential all-reduce operations with intermediate element-wise scaling and un-scaling operations between stages. Each all-reduce is a separate dispatch on the full W*S vector. Total ~8 all-reduce dispatches plus local compute. Represents the baseline reference pattern with no structural optimization.

strategies.name: Fused local-ops between all-reduces
strategies.desc: Groups all element-wise operations (scale by a[r], divide by W, divide by a[r]) into single fused kernels between each all-reduce stage, reducing local compute dispatches from ~24 to ~8. Still performs 8 all-reduce dispatches but minimizes local op overhead through kernel fusion. Trades implementation complexity for reduced launch overhead.

strategies.name: Vectorized scaling with precomputed coefficients
strategies.desc: Precomputes the compound scaling factors for all 8 stages offline, then applies them as vector multiplications using broadcasting/view operations. Maintains 8 all-reduce dispatches but replaces per-shard loops with single vectorized ops per stage (~8 local dispatches total). Exploits regularity in the scale pattern a[r%4].

strategies.name: Reduce-scatter then all-gather pattern
strategies.desc: Decomposes each all-reduce into reduce-scatter followed by all-gather, applying local scaling operations on the smaller scattered chunks (size S instead of W*S) between collective phases. Doubles collective count to ~16 dispatches but reduces intermediate buffer size and memory bandwidth for local operations by factor of W.

strategies.name: Pipelined multi-stage with overlapped compute-communication
strategies.desc:
Splits the W*S tensor into chunks and pipelines the 8-stage reduction across chunks, overlapping all-reduce communication on chunk[i] with local scaling computation on chunk[i+1]. Requires chunk-wise all-reduce support (or manual send/recv ring). Same total communication volume but hides local-op latency behind network transfers.
